purpose: Isolated experimental layer for testing business hypotheses and interaction prototypes without silently changing accepted Website Ventures decisions, assets or customer data.

sourceHierarchy.rule: Evidence can promote a lab hypothesis into HQ; a lab hypothesis never overwrites HQ by itself.

guardrails: No prospect calls, emails, DMs or form submissions from the Lab without Joey explicitly requesting outreach.
No fake reviews, client projects, certifications, staff identity or performance claims.
No paid Higgsfield/video generation credits are spent from autonomous Lab work.
Accepted Website Lab variants are never overwritten; new variants are additive.
Do not scale to students, salespeople or provinces before the first delivery and sales loop is proven.

activePrototype.visualReference: Product A direction: thin glass/chrome tablet over large rough pale stone in a calm premium architectural environment with restrained oxblood red.
activePrototype.motionReference: Higgsfield 3D Jutsu motion v7: friendly smooth diagonal lift, less zoom, tablet edges remain visible, soft peak, return to the same stone.
interactionContract: Start with the tablet resting on the same large pale stone.
Scroll lifts the tablet diagonally and rotates it toward upright with smooth continuous interpolation.
At the peak the tablet fills most, but not all, of the viewport so its physical edges remain visible.
The tablet screen becomes real HTML and shows coded Website Ventures demos rather than generated fake website screenshots.
First live preview is Premium Plumbing; second prototype preview is the preserved Architectural Luxury scroll test.
Later scroll returns the same tablet to the same stone, reserving the end state for a future CTA.
deliberatelyDeferred: final business name and typography lock
activePrototype.nextGate: Joey scroll-tests the Lab prototype on desktop and gives motion/composition feedback before the prototype is integrated into the broader agency showroom.

currentWorkingModel.offer: Premium website for local service/trade businesses without the owner having to manage a web agency project.
currentWorkingModel.scope: Up to 3 core pages, one bundled revision round, mobile + desktop, contact flow, basic technical SEO/analytics and launch after complete intake.

offerExperiments.name: Premium Refresh
offerExperiments.promotionRule: Keep until real conversations and first paid clients create evidence for changing it.

offerExperiments.name: Premium Plus
offerExperiments.promotionRule: Test only if Offer A sells without major price resistance and delivery is consistently <=6 hours.

offerExperiments.name: Fast Onepager
offerExperiments.promotionRule: Use only if discovery shows the niche wants materially less scope and values speed more than page count.

nicheWorkingScores.warning: Internal decision scores, not market facts. Real prospect behavior overrides them.

evidenceGates.question: Does the target recognize the problem and agree the current online presentation is costing trust/opportunity?
evidenceGates.failureResponse: Change ICP/message before investing further in design volume.

evidenceGates.question: Does the flagship create enough desire to generate a serious commercial conversation?
evidenceGates.failureResponse: Fix demo/offer before adding more niches.

evidenceGates.question: Can Joey repeatedly close, deliver and support the founding offer?
evidenceGates.failureResponse: Do not hire or expand geography yet.

scaleGates: Delivery repeatedly at or below roughly 6 hours after complete intake.
At least three genuine customers/cases with usable feedback or proof.
A sales process with enough repeated observations to estimate conversion rather than guess it.
A reusable component/visual system so another builder can follow a standard without degrading quality.
productionOrder: AG-HERO visual/material fidelity only after motion architecture is accepted
PL-STORY still sequence with same technician/world
PL-PROOF reusable frame for genuine customer evidence
PL-MOTION only for approved winning stills
